title: sapium marginatum var. obovatum
intro: Sapium marginatum var. obovatum, commonly known as the Yellow Sapindus or Yellow Soapbark, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. The Yellow Sapindus is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include reducing inflammation, preventing the growth of microorganisms, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the Yellow Sapindus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
